response.sql: WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as baseline_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), above_baseline AS (SELECT sa.station_avg, (sa.station_avg - b.baseline_avg) as excess FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE sa.station_avg > b.baseline_avg) SELECT AVG(station_avg) as mean_of_station_averages, AVG(excess) as mean_excess FROM above_baseline
